zh.title: 更清晰的发送状态与项目操作
items: 手机端不再显示“新对话已写入 Codex”提示；每条用户消息右下角以勾表示发送成功、旋转进度表示发送进行中、感叹号表示发送失败。
手机端侧边栏在每个已展开项目下提供独立操作行，统一放置“配置”和“新增会话”，让常用项目操作更集中。
手机端子任务不再标注 Kimi 或 Codex，只保留任务内容与状态，减少不必要的视觉信息。

en.title: Clearer send status and project actions
items: Mobile no longer shows the ‘New conversation written to Codex’ notice; each user message now uses a check mark for success, a spinner while sending, and an exclamation mark on failure.
The mobile sidebar adds a dedicated action row beneath every expanded project, bringing Configuration and New Session together in one consistent place.
Mobile subtasks no longer carry Kimi or Codex labels, leaving only the task content and status to reduce unnecessary visual noise.
